method.surface: Authenticated NYC Artist Coalition Facebook Page feed
method.reconciliation: Private platform-generated post identities paired transient render variants; those identities and authenticated URLs are excluded from this public fixture.
limitations: This is the complete capture-date population exposed by the authenticated live Page feed, not a native Meta owner export or proof of complete lifetime history.
Deleted, hidden, private, unpublished, or no-longer-retained posts may remain outside the recovered population.
The shared Page identity does not identify the historical human author of each post.
Displayed interaction counts are volatile interface values, not reach, attendance, conversion, endorsement, unique people, mandate, or impact.

stakeholderSummary.boundary: Stakeholder tags describe account-level references, tags, routes, and issue interfaces. They do not establish that every named stakeholder engaged with, endorsed, or formally partnered with NYC Artist Coalition.

displayedInteractionSummary.boundary: Share counts were not displayed on the capture surface. Zero displayed shares is not a claim that no sharing occurred. All displayed counts are volatile capture-date labels, not reach, attendance, conversion, endorsement, unique people, mandate, or impact.
